title: 🎨 Emojis, Colors + New Sub-folder Look
message: Make your vault feel like yours. Give your tags and sub-folders any emoji you like, pick any color for your tags, and enjoy a cleaner sub-folder view.
points: 😀 Emojis for Tags: When you make a new tag, tap the emoji box and pick any emoji from your keyboard. It shows on your tag everywhere, like 🎮 Gaming or 🍳 Recipes.
📂 Emojis for Sub-folders: Give your sub-folders an emoji too, so you can find them at a glance.
🎨 Pick Any Color: Choose from ready colors, or tap the rainbow circle to open the new color picker. Drag to find the exact shade you want, or type a color code.
✏️ Edit Your Tags: Hold a tag while saving an item to change its emoji and color, or delete it. Locked tags stay locked.
🔲 New Sub-folder Grid: Sub-folders now show as neat tiles in a grid, just like your Folders tab.
👆 Hold to Change: In the Folders tab, hold your own tag folder to set its emoji. Inside a folder, hold a sub-folder to change its emoji.
↩️ Reset Anytime: Don't like the new look? Tap Reset to go back to the original icon.
🛡️ Smart Folders Stay Smart: Folders made for you automatically, like YouTube, PDF or Images, keep their own icons.
🛠️ Small fixes and improvements.

title: 📅 No More Double Saves + Browse by Date
message: Ever saved the same video or link twice without knowing? SaveAnything now tells you when something is already in your vault, and your saves are neatly grouped by day.
points: 🔍 Already Saved Check: Save a link, note, photo or file you already have and we'll show it to you first. Tap View to see it, or Save again if you want another copy.
📍 Takes You Right There: Tap View and the app scrolls straight to your saved item and makes it glow, so you can open, edit or delete it.
⬆️⬇️ Jump Between Copies: Saved the same thing more than once? Use the up and down buttons to move between every copy, just like search in a PDF.
🧹 New Repeated Filter: On Home, tap Repeated to see only the items you saved more than once, grouped together so cleaning up is easy.
📤 Smarter Sharing: When you share many items at once, the ones you already saved are skipped for you.
📅 Saves by Date: Home, Favorites and Folders now show your items under Today, Yesterday and the date you saved them.
🗓️ Jump to Any Day: Tap a date and a calendar opens with only the days you saved something. Pick a day and we take you there.
🛠️ Small fixes and improvements.

title: 🔔 Reminders Are Here! Never Forget Your Saves
message: Saved something and forgot about it? Not anymore! SaveAnything can now remind you to come back to the things you save.
points: ⏰ Remind Me: Get a notification for any item. Choose In 1 hour, Tonight, Tomorrow morning, This weekend, or pick your own date and time.
🔁 Repeat Until Opened: Pick Daily or Weekly and we'll keep reminding you until you open it or mark it as read.
💎 Forgotten Gems: Once a day, we show you an old save you never opened. You choose the time and days.
🔥 Open Streak: Open at least one saved item every day and grow your streak.
🆕 Unopened Filter: See all the things you saved but never opened, right from Home.
⚙️ Full Control: Go to Insights → Reminders to change times, turn things on or off, and see all upcoming reminders.
🔒 Private: Locked items never show their name in notifications.
🗜️ New Zip Icon: Zip and archive files now have a cleaner icon.
🛠️ Small fixes and improvements.

title: ✨ A Fresh New Look & Smarter Sharing! 📤
message: SaveAnything has a brand-new, clean design that's easier to read and nicer to use. Saving from other apps is now simpler too!
points: 🎨 New Clean Design: A simpler, modern look across Home, Folders, Favorites and the save screen.
📤 Better Sharing: Share a link, photo, video or file from any app and a save screen opens so you can add a title, folder, tags or lock before saving.
🗂️ Grid or List View: Switch between a neat grid and a simple list with one tap. Your choice is remembered.
🖼️ Smarter Link Previews: Better thumbnails and titles for YouTube, shopping sites, articles, Spotify and more.
🏷️ Easy Filters: Filter your saves by folder or tag right from Home, with site logos shown.
🔑 Forgot Your PIN?: You can now reset it safely and set a new one.
🛠️ Faster & Smoother: Lots of small fixes and improvements.

title: 🔒 Private Vault Lock & Passcode Protection! 🛡️
message: Keep your personal items completely private! You can now secure your links, files, images, and notes behind a master passcode.
points: 🔐 Lock Anything: Easily lock individual items or entire folders with a 4-digit Master PIN.
🛡️ Auto-Lock Protection: Your locked items automatically secure themselves the moment you close or minimize the app.
🔑 Secret Recovery Key: Never lose access—reset your passcode anytime using your custom security question.
🎲 Private Vault Roulette: Locked items stay hidden in the Roulette reel until you choose to unlock them.
✨ Performance & UI Improvements: Smoother animations, updated security indicators, and bug fixes.

title: ✨ DevDuo Hub Update & Direct Play Store Access! 🚀
message: We've made it even easier to connect with us! Now you can visit our official Google Play Store page directly from inside the app.
points: 🏪 Play Store Page Button: Added a direct 'Visit Play Store Page' button in the DevDuo Hub so you can easily discover all our apps and games on Google Play.
🎨 UI Refinements: Enhanced button styles and layouts inside the DevDuo Software Hub for a cleaner look.
⚡ Performance & Stability: Minor bug fixes to keep your app running fast and smooth.

title: ✨ Introducing the DevDuo Software Hub! 🚀
message: We're expanding our world! Discover new apps and explore our growing software ecosystem directly inside SaveAnything.
points: 🌐 DevDuo Software Hub: Browse, filter, and discover all current and upcoming DevDuo apps and games in one organized space.
🎴 One-Tap Access Cards: Tap the new DevDuo promotion cards at the bottom of your Insights tab or update dialogs to open the hub.
🚀 Smoother Performance: Minor bug fixes and UI enhancements for a cleaner, faster vault experience.

title: ⚡ The 'Lighning Fast' Performance Update! 🚀
message: Experience pure speed! We've optimized internal saving loops and animations to give you a flawlessly fluid vault experience.
points: ⚡ Faster Quick Saving: Saving links, media, notes, and documents from external share menus is now near-instantaneous.
🪄 Fluid Tab Switches: Shifting between content source types (Link, File, Media, Note) is completely smooth and lag-free.
🛠️ Under-The-Hood Tuning: Upgraded local caching systems to load extensive folders and heavy layouts without a single drop in performance.

title: ✔️ The 'Inbox Zero' Update! 📥
message: Keep your vault clutter-free! You can now mark items as Read and hide them from your main feed.
points: ✔️ Mark as Read: Easily track what you've already watched, read, or used by marking items as 'Completed'.
👁️ Smart Hide Toggle: Tap the new eye icon on the home screen to instantly hide your completed items and focus on the new stuff.
📂 Dedicated Read Vault: Access all your completed items perfectly categorized in the new 'Reads' bottom-sheet inside the Folders Tab.
⚙️ Engine Upgrades: We've optimized the local database for lightning-fast sorting and seamless tag filtering.

title: 📊 Live Filter Counters & Better Flow! ✨
message: We've added context right to your dashboard tabs! Track your data volume instantly without clicking back and forth.
points: 📊 Live Content Badges: Horizontal filter chips now display live badges tracking your exact saved volume counts across links, files, notes, and media.
🧹 Tap-to-Clear Fields: Instantly erase long link inputs or description mistakes using clean, fast zero-out suffix buttons.
⌨️ Smart Keyboard Unfocus: Integrated text input actions to automatically dismiss soft keyboards the second you submit your search queries.

title: 🎲 Welcome to Vault Roulette! ✨
message: Stop hoarding and start exploring! We've added a stunning new way to rediscover the links and files you've saved.
points: 📱 The Reel Experience: Swipe vertically through your forgotten saves in an immersive, full-screen reel.
🎨 Rich Color Previews: Experience beautiful, dynamic background gradients that adapt to your saved images.
⚡ Clean Up & Consume: Instantly open forgotten links or trash them with one tap while scrolling.
💎 UI Polish: Smoother animations and enhanced premium visual touches across the app.

title: ✨ The Update Hub is Here! 🚀
message: We've crafted a beautiful new way to keep you perfectly in sync with our latest SaveAnything features.
points: 🔔 In-App Updater: Get instantly notified about fresh features directly when you open your vault.
📖 Interactive Changelogs: Discover exactly what's new the moment you update.
⚡ Performance Boost: Under-the-hood tweaks for an even faster link saving experience.
